blocking_findings.summary: Evidence with a future effective_from is accepted when published_at is eligible.
blocking_findings.evidence: agents/executor_helpers/sentiment_helper.py:248 selects published_at OR effective_from, so published_at wins whenever both exist. The reviewer probe used published_at=2026-06-20, effective_from=2026-07-01 and as_of=2026-06-30; select_point_in_time_evidence returned eligible_count=1 with no rejection.
blocking_findings.contract_violation: The Stage 06 owner contract requires published/effective time <= as_of before scoring and again before aggregation. The implementation artifact's claim that future evidence is rejected before scoring is therefore false for this valid metadata shape.

blocking_findings.summary: Document grouping happens before temporal filtering and can merge a future chunk into an eligible past document.
blocking_findings.evidence: tools/sentiment_tools/sentiment_server.py:252-291 groups all chunks by canonical document key and retains only the first chunk's timestamp; temporal selection runs afterward at lines 292-306. The reviewer probe supplied one past and one future chunk with the same canonical URL and received chunks=['eligible text\n\nFUTURE TEXT'], temporal_rejections=[], eligible_docs=1.
blocking_findings.contract_violation: A post-as_of text can reach FinBERT/VADER and change a historical score, violating future-news isolation and the requirement to filter before scoring.

blocking_findings.summary: The MCP dispatch handler does not require ForecastContext and run_id at execution time.
blocking_findings.evidence: tools/sentiment_tools/sentiment_server.py:563-567 validates identity only if either field is present; when both are absent it runs the legacy current-path retrieval without as_of/dataset_version/historical. tests/unit_tests/sentiment_test/test_sentiment_server.py:192-200 explicitly asserts that retrieve_social_data succeeds with only query, and the analyzer/scorer/fusion routing tests also omit identity.
blocking_findings.contract_violation: Schema declarations alone do not enforce the Stage 06 rule that every sentiment execution requires ForecastContext/run identity and that historical sentiment has no current fallback.

non_blocking_findings.summary: The FinBERT version label calls a 40-character Git revision a sha256 revision.
non_blocking_findings.assessment: The pinned commit is immutable and local-files-only, so reproducibility is adequate, but the label 'sha256-revision' is technically inaccurate and should be renamed to an unambiguous git-revision field during rework.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Live providers and external trace export remain unverified by design.
non_blocking_findings.assessment: Offline fixtures and local models are appropriate under the no-network authorization. This does not excuse the deterministic temporal defects reproduced locally.

required_rework.requirement: Validate every present temporal field independently. Reject when published_at or effective_from is invalid or later than as_of; do not use an OR choice that hides a future effective_from. Repeat the same invariant before aggregation and add boundary tests.

Apply point-in-time eligibility to individual chunks before document grouping, or conservatively reject a document containing any ineligible revision. Add a same-canonical-URL past/future test proving future text never reaches the scored chunks.

Require and validate forecast_context and run_id unconditionally in call_tool before dispatch. Ensure retrieval cannot enter a current/no-as_of path and update legacy routing tests to provide explicit point-in-time identity or assert fail-closed behavior.

review_blockers: The current accepted-attempt candidate permits future evidence to affect historical sentiment in two reproducible paths.
The runtime MCP handler permits sentiment execution without the mandatory ForecastContext/run identity.

resolved_findings.evidence: Private query and free-form provider error text are excluded from logs, progress, Sentry and compact Shared State by fixed labels/error codes and allowlisted processors; exact offline privacy sentinels passed.
Eight Stage 06 lifecycle boundaries now carry forecast/run/version identity, measured non-negative latency, semantic counts and bounded degraded flags.
The traced MCP child boundary catches and replaces raw provider/transport and malformed-payload exceptions before they cross the trace boundary.
FinBERT uses an immutable local commit with local_files_only and VADER records the SHA-256 of local lexicon bytes; no automatic model or lexicon download is used.

contract_audit.scope_and_locks: PASS: all 18 implementation-recorded paths and the reviewer artifact have exact owner locks. All 16 recorded source/test/fixture SHA-256 values match. No Stage 07 product work, Manager, Quant, database, migration, dependency, deploy, commit, push, seed or deletion path was entered.
contract_audit.artifact_integrity: PASS: Stage 05 is CLOSED; draft-ready, observability, change-request, implementation MD/JSON and QA are the same Stage 06 revision 1 attempt 1, all input SHA-256 values match, QA is PASS, and every input validates under the current control plane.
contract_audit.temporal_safety: FAIL_BLOCKING: effective_from can be after as_of when published_at is eligible, and future chunks sharing a canonical document identity can be merged into a past document before temporal filtering. Both defects were independently reproduced and allow future content to be scored.
contract_audit.forecast_identity_and_provider_policy: FAIL_BLOCKING: the MCP schemas list forecast_context/run_id as required, but call_tool does not enforce them when both are absent and can dispatch retrieval without as_of, dataset_version or historical=True.
contract_audit.window_and_feature_shape: PASS_WITH_BLOCKING_INPUT_CAVEAT: fixed 7/14/30 calendar-day aggregates, momentum, dispersion, volumes, source diversity, confidence, evidence IDs and explicit missing/degraded flags are implemented. Their correctness is not acceptable while ineligible future inputs can enter scoring.
contract_audit.model_reproducibility: PASS: FinBERT is pinned to local immutable revision 4556d13015211d73dccd3fdd39d39232506f3e43 with deterministic settings; VADER includes local lexicon SHA-256 and disables download; fusion is versioned.
contract_audit.state_and_data_hygiene: PASS: Shared State commits compact sentiment summary and feature slot only. brain_reasoning, full attempts, raw chunks, source metadata and model chunk scores remain private and are excluded by the persistence allowlist.
contract_audit.observability_and_privacy: PASS: OBS-06-001 through OBS-06-004 are substantively resolved; traces/progress/errors use allowlisted identity, counts, flags and stable codes without raw payloads or private exception messages.
contract_audit.financial_and_numeric_integrity: PASS_BY_SCOPE: Stage 06 does not modify Financial DCF/WACC or nine intent/mappers, does not modify Quant, and does not introduce an LLM-authored 21-session numeric forecast.
contract_audit.scientific_honesty: PASS_BY_SCOPE: artifacts claim offline engineering validation only, disclose absent live-provider validation and retain five known baseline/out-of-scope failures. No investment-success or backtest-performance claim is made.
contract_audit.regression: PASS_TEST_EXECUTION_BUT_INSUFFICIENT_CONTRACT_COVERAGE: the independent official Stage 06 suite passed 164 tests with 5 live tests deselected and one deprecation warning; however it lacks the three exact cases identified by this review.
contract_audit.operational_safety: PASS: rollback is documented and no database read/write, migration application, seed, deletion, deployment, commit or push is reported or observed.
